title: Contextual Linear Activation Steering of Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2604.24693v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Linear activation steering is a powerful approach for controlling and specializing large language models by adding linear representations of concepts to their activations at inference. While effective, existing methods often steer with a fixed strength, independent of how much steering any given input requires. In this work, we introduce Contextual Linear Activation Steering (CLAS), which decomposes activation steering into a fixed steering direction and a context-dependent steering coefficient. This decomposition preserves the interpretability of the steering direction while enabling the steering strength to vary with context. It also enables CLAS to perform selective steering: steering multiple behaviors across different portions of a single generation, which cannot be achieved using a fixed steering strength. In addition, across a wide range of steering benchmarks and language models, CLAS consistently outperforms standard linear

translated_title: 语言模型的上下文线性激活导向
translated_abstract: 线性激活导向是一种强大的方法，它通过在推理时向大型语言模型的激活中添加概念的线性表示，来控制和专门化这些模型。虽然行之有效，但现有方法通常以固定强度进行导向，而不考虑任何给定输入实际需要多大程度的导向。在这项工作中，我们引入了上下文线性激活导向（CLAS），它将激活导向分解为一个固定的导向方向和一个依赖上下文的导向系数。这种分解在保留导向方向可解释性的同时，使导向强度能够随上下文而变化。它还使CLAS能够执行选择性导向：在单次生成的不同部分引导多种行为，这是使用固定导向强度无法实现的。此外，在广泛的导向基准测试和语言模型上，CLAS始终优于标准的线性……
tldr: CLAS将激活导向分解为固定的导向方向和依赖上下文的导向系数，使导向强度能随输入上下文自适应变化，并实现了单次生成中针对不同部分引导多种行为的选择性导向，在多项基准测试中持续优于固定强度的传统线性激活导向方法。
en_tdlr: CLAS decomposes activation steering into a fixed steering direction and a context-dependent coefficient, enabling adaptive steering strength that varies with input context and selective steering of multiple behaviors within a single generation, consistently outperforming standard fixed-strength linear steering methods across benchmarks and models.
